verdicts.reason: A: the headline is split into 'CONS TRUC TION' with stray spaces and set far too small for a 432x768 canvas. The brick is pixelated and cropped at the right edge, and the X shape is clipped too. 'Buy 2 only for', ORDER NOW and $14.99 sit in one tiny row with the price on the far side of the button, so the offer reads in the wrong order. B: it has the same broken, tiny headline and a large empty band at the top. $14.99 is cut off from 'Buy 2 only for', the X floats with nothing on it, and the brick (the key product image) has shrunk to a thumbnail in the bottom-left corner.
